name: Children Being A Blessing
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a precious heritage and reward from the LORD, entrusted to parents as a divine blessing (Psalms 127:3). From conception, God is intimately involved in their formation (Psalms 139:13), and they bring honor both to their ancestors and their fathers (Proverbs 17:6). The Bible emphasizes the importance of training children in the ways of the Lord, promising that such instruction will endure throughout their lives (Proverbs 22:6), and assures that when children are taught by God, they will experience great peace (Isaiah 54:13). Thus, children are not only a blessing to be cherished but also a responsibility to be nurtured under God’s guidance.
